events.text:
Implemented a general repair for batched parametric canonicalization.

The bug was in reshaping sparse parameter tensors: the code incorrectly used the global parameter-slice index as the matrix coordinate. Indexed 3-D parameters therefore produced invalid column indices. It also discarded repeated entries created by broadcasting.

Fixed both supported Python canonicalization backends:

- [scipy_backend.py](/workspace/task/source/cvxpy/lin_ops/backends/scipy_backend.py:355)
- [coo_backend.py](/workspace/task/source/cvxpy/lin_ops/backends/coo_backend.py:1157)

The corrected implementations:

- Separate the parameter-slice index from the entry’s position within that slice.
- Derive matrix rows and columns from the within-slice position.
- Preserve all entries, including duplicate placements introduced by broadcasting.
